turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Hi! I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, plus the new delivery address.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.
Comanda SC-3360 a fost deja expediată, iar adresa se poate schimba doar până la expediere. Am transmis cererea ta unui coleg, care va decide și va prelua conversația.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer (nora.blake@example.com) asks to change delivery address on SC-3360 to "Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu". Policy says address can change only until shipping; order already shipped, so a person must decide.
